description: Look up Google Fonts families by name, browse by category, list the entire library, or list Material icon metadata. Search, filter, sort, and optionally enrich records with license/attribution and self-hosting file URLs.

brandOnly.description: Keep only families where the upstream `isBrandFont` flag is true. In the current catalog this flag equals `isNoto`; it is not a generic brand filter.
brandOnly.title: Google-branded flag only

category.description: Filter the library to a single font category. Defaults to `Sans Serif` when empty. An unknown category emits a typed `invalid_category` error record.
category.title: Category (mode=byCategory)

colorOnly.description: Keep only families with color font capabilities (COLRV0/COLRV1/OTSVG).
colorOnly.title: Color fonts only

designers.description: Only keep families whose designer/foundry list contains every listed value (case-insensitive substring match).
designers.title: Designers

families.description: Font family names, e.g. `Roboto`, `Open Sans`, `Lora`, `Playfair Display`. Case-insensitive; `displayName` aliases and duplicates are handled. Defaults to `Roboto` when empty.
families.title: Font families (mode=byFamily)

includeFiles.description: Fetch the full CSS2 stylesheet (woff2/unicode-range) and the download manifest (TTF URLs). Capped by `maxFilesPerFamily`. CSS2 output depends on the user agent: the actor requests a modern Chrome UA and retries once with Safari when Chrome receives only TTF. Large CJK families can exceed the file cap. Off by default; enable it to add these fields. Raw API calls that omit the key retain the legacy `byFamily` auto-enable. Ignored in `icons` mode.
includeFiles.title: Include font file URLs

includeLicense.description: Enrich each family with license, license URL, copyright, source repository, source date, languages, unicode coverage, and description. Uses the per-family metadata endpoint, then METADATA.pb, then the download manifest. Off by default; enable it to add these fields. Raw API calls that omit the key retain the legacy `byFamily` auto-enable. The catalog-level `languages` array is always empty upstream, so `languages` can only come from this per-family enrichment. Ignored in `icons` mode.
includeLicense.title: Include license & attribution

maxFilesPerFamily.description: Cap applied separately to `fontFiles` (CSS2) and `ttfFiles` (manifest). CJK families can expose hundreds of files; for example M PLUS 1p has 882 CSS2 blocks, so the 200 default truncates it and `filesTruncated` is set. Raise to 1000 to keep them all.
maxFilesPerFamily.title: Max files per family

maxItems.description: Hard cap on records emitted per run (1-5000). Defaults to 5000 so the whole font catalog (~1,959 families) fits without truncation. The icon endpoint currently reports about 6,139 icons, so `icons` mode can truncate at the cap.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to fetch from Google Fonts. `icons` fetches the separate Material icon metadata document once and emits icon records; it does not return font-family records.
enumTitles: Lookup specific font families by name
mode.title: Mode

notoOnly.description: Keep only families in the Noto collection.
notoOnly.title: Noto families only

search.description: Free-text search over family, display name, category, classifications, subsets, designers, and primary script/language. In `icons` mode it searches icon name, categories, tags, and supported families. All space-separated tokens must match.
search.title: Search text

sortBy.description: Order the matched families. `popularity` and `trending` are sparse upstream snapshot ranks where lower is better (not dense 1..N positions); `dateAdded` and `lastModified` put newest first. In `icons` mode only `popularity` and `name` change the order; other values keep upstream order.
sortBy.title: Sort by

subsets.description: Only keep families that include every listed subset, e.g. `latin`, `cyrillic`, `greek`, `vietnamese`. The synthetic `menu` subset is present on every family.
subsets.title: Language subsets

variableOnly.description: Keep only families that ship a variable font with one or more axes.
variableOnly.title: Variable fonts only

title: Google Fonts Scraper Input
